universal.workload: Adopt Generative AI to automate short-answer + case-study grading + AI-driven question generation for Certifiable, Inc., a professional-architecture certification body. Absorb 5–10× candidate growth (30,000 to 150,000–300,000 exams/year) without exhausting the pool of 300 retired-architect SME graders. Preserve grading accuracy at or above SME baseline, preserve accreditor-facing credibility, cap total per-exam cost at ≤130% of today's, and detect + prevent candidates cheating with GenAI. Integrate with the existing exam system without disrupting workflow.
